mapper.select: SELECT R.*, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(A.ATTR_NM,'=',IFNULL(A.ATTR_VALUE,'')) ORDER BY A.SORT_SEQ SEPARATOR '\n') ATTR_TEXT FROM resource_info R LEFT JOIN resource_attr A ON A.RESOURCE_SN=R.RESOURCE_SN AND A.USE_YN='Y' WHERE R.CO_ID=#{coId} AND R.USE_YN='Y' AND (R.RESOURCE_NM LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchKeyword},'%') OR R.LOCATION_NM LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchKeyword},'%')) GROUP BY R.RESOURCE_SN ORDER BY R.RESOURCE_TYPE_CD,R.RESOURCE_NM

SELECT R.*,GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(A.ATTR_NM,'=',IFNULL(A.ATTR_VALUE,'')) ORDER BY A.SORT_SEQ SEPARATOR '\n') ATTR_TEXT FROM resource_info R LEFT JOIN resource_attr A ON A.RESOURCE_SN=R.RESOURCE_SN AND A.USE_YN='Y' WHERE R.RESOURCE_SN=#{resourceSn} AND R.CO_ID=#{coId} AND R.USE_YN='Y' GROUP BY R.RESOURCE_SN
mapper.update: UPDATE resource_info SET RESOURCE_NM=#{resourceNm},RESOURCE_TYPE_CD=#{resourceTypeCd},LOCATION_NM=#{locationNm},RESOURCE_EXPLN=#{resourceExpln},BOOKABLE_YN=#{bookableYn},USE_MODE_CD=#{useModeCd},MDFCN_DT=NOW(),MDFR_ID=#{mdfrId} WHERE RESOURCE_SN=#{resourceSn} AND CO_ID=#{coId} AND USE_YN='Y'
UPDATE resource_attr SET USE_YN='N' WHERE RESOURCE_SN=#{value}
UPDATE resource_info SET USE_YN='N',MDFCN_DT=NOW(),MDFR_ID=#{mdfrId} WHERE RESOURCE_SN=#{resourceSn} AND CO_ID=#{coId} AND USE_YN='Y'
mapper.select: SELECT V.RESERVATION_SN,V.RESOURCE_SN,V.SCHDL_SN,V.USER_ID,U.USER_NM,V.BIZ_ID,B.BIZ_NM,V.RSV_TITLE,DATE_FORMAT(V.BGNG_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') BGNG_DT,DATE_FORMAT(V.END_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') END_DT,V.USE_CN,V.RSV_STTS_CD,R.RESOURCE_NM,R.RESOURCE_TYPE_CD,R.LOCATION_NM,R.USE_MODE_CD FROM resource_reservation V JOIN resource_info R ON R.RESOURCE_SN=V.RESOURCE_SN LEFT JOIN user_info U ON U.USER_ID=V.USER_ID LEFT JOIN biz_info B ON B.BIZ_ID=V.BIZ_ID WHERE V.CO_ID=#{coId} AND V.USE_YN='Y' AND V.USER_ID=#{userId} ORDER BY V.BGNG_DT DESC,V.RESERVATION_SN DESC

SELECT V.*,R.RESOURCE_NM FROM resource_reservation V JOIN resource_info R ON R.RESOURCE_SN=V.RESOURCE_SN WHERE V.RESERVATION_SN=#{reservationSn} AND V.CO_ID=#{coId} AND V.USE_YN='Y' AND V.USER_ID=#{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resource_reservation WHERE RESOURCE_SN=#{resourceSn} AND CO_ID=#{coId} AND USE_YN='Y' AND RSV_STTS_CD='RESERVED' AND RESERVATION_SN != #{reservationSn} AND #{bgngDt} < END_DT AND #{endDt} > BGNG_DT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schdl_info(CO_ID,BIZ_ID,SCHDL_SE_CD,VAC_SE_CD,SCHDL_NM,BGNG_DT,END_DT,ALL_DAY_YN,PLACE_NM,SCHDL_CN,USE_YN,REG_DT,RGTR_ID) SELECT #{coId},#{bizId},'RESOURCE',NULL,CONCAT('[자원] ',R.RESOURCE_NM,' - ',#{rsvTitle}),#{bgngDt},#{endDt},'N',R.LOCATION_NM,#{useCn},'Y',NOW(),#{rgtrId} FROM resource_info R WHERE R.RESOURCE_SN=#{resourceSn} AND R.CO_ID=#{coId} AND R.USE_YN='Y' AND R.BOOKABLE_YN='Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE schdl_info S JOIN resource_info R ON R.RESOURCE_SN=#{resourceSn} SET S.BIZ_ID=#{bizId},S.SCHDL_NM=CONCAT('[자원] ',R.RESOURCE_NM,' - ',#{rsvTitle}),S.BGNG_DT=#{bgngDt},S.END_DT=#{endDt},S.PLACE_NM=R.LOCATION_NM,S.SCHDL_CN=#{useCn},S.MDFCN_DT=NOW(),S.MDFR_ID=#{mdfrId} WHERE S.SCHDL_SN=#{schdlSn} AND S.CO_ID=#{coId}

UPDATE resource_reservation SET RESOURCE_SN=#{resourceSn},BIZ_ID=#{bizId},RSV_TITLE=#{rsvTitle},BGNG_DT=#{bgngDt},END_DT=#{endDt},USE_CN=#{useCn},MDFCN_DT=NOW(),MDFR_ID=#{mdfrId} WHERE RESERVATION_SN=#{reservationSn} AND CO_ID=#{coId} AND USER_ID=#{userId} AND USE_YN='Y'
UPDATE resource_reservation SET USE_YN='N',RSV_STTS_CD='CANCELLED',MDFCN_DT=NOW(),MDFR_ID=#{mdfrId} WHERE RESERVATION_SN=#{reservationSn} AND CO_ID=#{coId} AND USER_ID=#{userId}
UPDATE schdl_info SET USE_YN='N',MDFCN_DT=NOW(),MDFR_ID=#{mdfrId} WHERE SCHDL_SN=#{schdlSn} AND CO_ID=#{coId}
mapper.select: SELECT B.BIZ_ID,B.BIZ_NM FROM biz_info B WHERE B.CO_ID=#{coId} AND (B.RGTR_ID=#{userId} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM biz_mnpw M WHERE M.BIZ_ID=B.BIZ_ID AND M.USER_ID=#{userId} AND M.USE_YN='Y')) ORDER BY B.BIZ_NM
